title: Mathematician sees DMT entities solving the four color theorem instantly
summary: Andrew Gallimore tells of Mathematician sees DMT entities solving the four color theorem instantly, about unspecified (recent) at DMT space, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: right. Uh, and yet these entities they they [snorts] do it instantaneously like less than a second and they do it repeatedly.

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a mathematician he calls Andress took DMT, a powerful drug that causes intense visions. According to Gallimore, Andress saw beings in that vision solving the four color theorem, a famously hard maths problem about colouring maps, in under a second and over and over again. If true, it would suggest that the beings people meet on DMT have minds far beyond ours.
